name: superhero
definition: 具有超常能力或特殊身份、由出版机构创作并归属于某一阵营的虚构人物 Counterexample: 普通人物角色：不具备超常能力设定，也不属于超级英雄出版体系；超级英雄须同时具备虚构人物身份与能力/阵营归属特征 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table superhero; provenance: direct source superhero

name: publisher
definition: 创作并发行超级英雄相关作品的商业组织 Counterexample: 发行渠道或零售商：只负责流通销售，不参与作品创作与角色版权持有 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table publisher; provenance: direct source publisher

name: alignment
definition: 超级英雄在道德立场上所属的类别划分 Counterexample: 种族或性别：描述人物生理与出身属性，不表达道德立场取向 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table alignment; provenance: direct source alignment

name: gender
definition: 用于标识人物性别归属的分类取值 Counterexample: 阵营：表达道德立场而非生理/社会性别属性 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table gender; provenance: direct source gender

name: race
definition: 用于标识人物出身族类归属的分类取值 Counterexample: 阵营：表达道德立场而非出身族类 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table race; provenance: direct source race

name: colour
definition: 用于描述人物外观特征的颜色取值 Counterexample: 属性：颜色是取值本身，属性是描述维度，二者不可混同 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table colour; provenance: direct source colour

name: attribute
definition: 用于描述超级英雄特征的维度名称 Counterexample: 颜色：颜色是具体取值，属性是可被赋值的描述维度 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table attribute; provenance: direct source attribute

name: superpower
definition: 超级英雄所具备的超常能力类型 Counterexample: 属性：属性是通用描述维度，超能力是特定的能力类型 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table superpower; provenance: direct source superpower

name: hero_attribute
definition: 记录某一超级英雄在某一属性维度上取值的关联信息条目 Counterexample: 属性定义本身：属性定义只描述维度名称，不承载具体人物的取值 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table hero_attribute; provenance: direct source hero_attribute

name: hero_power
definition: 记录某一超级英雄拥有某一超能力的关联信息条目 Counterexample: 超能力定义本身：超能力定义只描述能力类型，不承载具体人物的拥有关系 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table hero_power; provenance: direct source hero_power

name: Superhero
definition: A named character in the superhero table.

name: FullName
definition: The full (real) name of a superhero.

name: Publisher
definition: The publishing company that owns the superhero.

name: Gender
definition: The gender of a superhero.

name: Race
definition: The species/race of a superhero.

name: EyeColour
definition: The eye colour of a superhero.

name: Height
definition: The height of a superhero in centimetres.

name: Weight
definition: The weight of a superhero in kilograms.

name: Attribute
definition: A numeric attribute score of a superhero (e.g. strength, intelligence, speed).

name: Superpower
definition: A special ability possessed by a superhero.

name: HeroCount
definition: Total number of superheroes matching a condition. Formula: COUNT(Superhero). Inputs: Superhero = superhero.superhero_name

name: EyeColourPopularity
definition: Ranking of eye colours by number of heroes. Formula: COUNT(Superhero) GROUP BY EyeColour ORDER BY COUNT DESC. Inputs: Superhero = superhero.superhero_name; EyeColour = colour.colour

name: MaleSuperpowerCount
definition: Number of distinct superpowers held by male superheroes. Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT Superpower) WHERE Gender='Male'. Inputs: Superpower = superpower.power_name; Gender = gender.gender

name: HairColour
